title: Determinant line
statement:
Use the lisse Weil sheaves and geometric-Frobenius convention of [def-wf-fundamental-representation], with coefficients $\Qlb=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and underlying lisse adic sheaves as in [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Let $\mathcal V=(\mathcal F,\varphi)$ have rank $r\geq0$, with Weil fundamental representation $\rho:W(X_0)\to\operatorname{GL}(V)$ on its geometric stalk $V$.

Its *determinant line* is the rank-one Weil representation
$$
\det(V):=\bigwedge\nolimits^r_{\Qlb}V,
\qquad
\det(\rho)(g)(v_1\wedge\cdots\wedge v_r)
=\rho(g)v_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\rho(g)v_r.
$$
Here exterior powers are those of [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], with the induced representation action of [sk-d-linear]. The top exterior power is one-dimensional by [lem-weil-pbc-exterior-power-free-basis]. Equivalently, $g$ acts on this line by the scalar
$$
\det(\rho)(g)=\det(\rho(g)),
$$
where the scalar determinant is [def-weil-endomorphism-determinant].

The corresponding rank-one lisse Weil sheaf is denoted $\det(\mathcal V)$. Explicitly it is $(\bigwedge^r\mathcal F,\bigwedge^r\varphi)$: exterior powers are formed on local coefficient modules of an adic model and its transition maps, then rationalized and extended to $\Qlb$ in the convention of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Its Weil structure is the map $\Phi_X^*(\bigwedge^r\mathcal F)\cong\bigwedge^r(\Phi_X^*\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{\bigwedge^r\varphi}\bigwedge^r\mathcal F$, using the reindexing pullback of [def-wf-lisse-adic-automorphism-pullback]. For $r=0$ these definitions give the constant line with trivial Weil action.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q04-76b128a4f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Definition split with no new nodes. It keeps all three clauses of the main-20261015 text (order 2863, identical to master): the top exterior power with the induced wedge action, the scalar det(rho(g)), and the rank-one Weil sheaf (wedge^r F, wedge^r phi). I read every stmt_dep statement. The fundamental representation supplies the setting and the geometric-Frobenius convention. The def-pod lisse systems give a lisse wedge^r F_n, because exterior powers commute with reduction mod varpi^n, rationalization and scalar extension. The exterior-algebra, free-basis C(r,r)=1 and determinant leaves give the line and its scalar. Reindexing pullback makes Phi^*(wedge^r F) = wedge^r(Phi^*F) on sections, so the Weil structure points the correct way. Edge cases checked: r=0 gives the trivial line, r=1 gives V itself, diagonal, swap and unipotent matrices behave correctly, Frobenius is not inverted, and continuity holds because det is polynomial. Dropping def-wf-weil-category (pro-etale D^b_c) is correct, since the input category is the lisse adic one; no coefficient swap. No cycle, no duplicate, citers unchanged in meaning, item not dropped, no repair note, not superseded on live. Batch-5 flags: def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves and def-wf-lisse-adic-automorphism-pullback are general coefficient and pullback definitions, not Poincare duality or the trace formula or their proofs. Both were already direct stmt_deps of the base dep def-wf-fundamental-representation, so the batch-5 closure gains nothing; accepted. No changes.
